title: AIAS Level 5 Longitudinal Evidence Campaign
purpose: Capture authentic production observations over time without fabricating organizational maturity.
scope: Authenticated hash-chained ledger, project events, criteria, metrics, professional reviews, recovery, incidents, improvements, audit attestations, CLI and dashboard status.

requirements.title: Tamper-evident ledger
requirements.statement: Every production record shall be sequenced, hash chained and authenticated with an externally supplied key.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Real observation controls
requirements.statement: The campaign shall reject future observations, duplicates, missing sources and invalid normative dimensions.
requirements.rationale: Prevent fabricated or ambiguous maturity evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Honest progress
requirements.statement: Campaign status shall derive window, unique completed projects, criteria and threshold metrics without prematurely claiming Level 5.
requirements.rationale: Keep capability and maturity claims separate.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Assessor interoperability
requirements.statement: Verified criterion observations shall project into production evidence accepted by the Level 5 assessor.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Secure operation
requirements.statement: The CLI shall obtain its signing key externally and shall not embed production secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The campaign shall include specification, traceability, tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
